FN-YLCU626-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 123
Committee: Veterans and Military Affairs Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/12/2025
Senate Bill 123as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund from receipts
obtained by law enforcement agencies from the sale of seized property by an undetermined
amount dependent upon the number of law enforcement agencies (LEAs) that fail to comply
with the reporting requirements of this bill on seizures and forfeitures to the Alabama Justice
Information Commission (AJIC) and the amounts obtained by the law enforcement agencies.
This would also reduce available funds obtained by the LEAs from the sale of seized property
by the same corresponding amount and from other funds available to the noncompliant LEAs to
pay all reasonable attorney fees and other costs incurred by the AJIC for seeking court action to
force LEA compliance with the provisions of this bill.
Additionally, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the AJIC to comply with
reporting requirements established pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
